content: Narendra Modi is the 14th and current Prime Minister of India, serving since 2014. He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has been a prominent figure in Indian politics for over two decades. Prior to becoming Prime Minister, he served as the Chief Minister of Gujarat from 2001 to 2014.

The Minister of Road Transport and Highways of India is Nitin Gadkari.
